sessions.title: Physical Concepts of Boundary Layer Theory
sessions.subtitle: Viscous flow past solid boundaries, no-slip condition, Prandtl's hypothesis, laminar-turbulent transition.
sessions.hook: Why does a fluid flow adhere completely to solid boundaries, creating a microscopic shear zone that dictates the drag on submarines and river channels?

sessions.title: Boundary Layer Thickness Definitions
sessions.subtitle: Nominal thickness (δ99), displacement thickness (δ*), momentum thickness (θ), and energy thickness (δ**).
sessions.hook: How much does a boundary layer displace the external streamlines outward, and what fraction of fluid momentum is lost to wall friction?

sessions.title: Von Kármán Momentum Integral Equation
sessions.subtitle: Control volume momentum balance, wall shear stress derivation, and zero-pressure-gradient simplification.
sessions.hook: How can an integral momentum balance across a simple rectangular control volume solve boundary layer growth without solving full Navier-Stokes equations?

sessions.title: Laminar Boundary Layer on a Flat Plate
sessions.subtitle: Blasius similarity solution, approximate velocity profiles (linear, parabolic, cubic), and growth rate δ(x).
sessions.hook: Why does the boundary layer thickness grow precisely as the square root of distance (√x) in laminar flow?

sessions.title: Turbulent Boundary Layer on a Flat Plate
sessions.subtitle: Prandtl's 1/7th power law, turbulent growth rate δ(x) ∝ x^0.8, logarithmic law of the wall.
sessions.hook: Why does turbulence cause a boundary layer to expand five times thicker than laminar flow, yet drastically resist flow separation?

sessions.title: Laminar Sublayer & Boundary Roughness
sessions.subtitle: Viscous sublayer (δ'), Nikuradse's sand roughness (ks), hydrodynamically smooth, transition, and rough boundaries.
sessions.hook: Can a microscopically rough concrete surface behave as hydrodynamically glass-smooth under low flow velocities?

sessions.title: Local and Average Skin Friction Drag
sessions.subtitle: Local coefficient Cfx, average drag coefficient CD, total drag computation on plates, mixed boundary layers.
sessions.hook: How do naval architects and hydraulic flume designers compute the exact friction drag force acting along submerged surfaces?

sessions.title: Boundary Layer Separation & Pressure Gradients
sessions.subtitle: Adverse pressure gradients (dp/dx > 0), inflection points, wall shear stress zero condition, wake formation.
sessions.hook: What causes fluid flow to suddenly detach from a spillway crest or bridge pier, generating devastating vortex shedding and cavitation?

sessions.title: Boundary Layer Control Methods & Civil Applications
sessions.subtitle: Suction, blowing, streamlining, vortex generators, spillway aeration, and wind engineering on structures.
sessions.hook: How do hydraulic engineers inject microscopic air bubbles into high-head spillway shoots to suppress cavitation damage completely?

sessions.title: Introduction to Free Surface Flow & Channel Geometry
sessions.subtitle: Open channel vs pipe flow, geometric elements (A, P, R, D, T), channel classifications, and flow regimes.
sessions.hook: Why does the presence of a free surface at constant atmospheric pressure make open channel hydraulics far richer and more complex than closed pipe flow?

sessions.title: Velocity Distribution & Kinetic Energy / Momentum Factors
sessions.subtitle: Logarithmic velocity profiles, Coriolis energy factor (α), Boussinesq momentum factor (β), governing 1D equations.
sessions.hook: Why is the point of maximum velocity in an open channel depressed 5% to 25% below the free surface rather than right at the top?

sessions.title: Uniform Flow: Chezy's & Manning's Equations
sessions.subtitle: Force equilibrium, Chezy coefficient C, Manning's n, factors affecting roughness, Cowan's method.
sessions.hook: How did Robert Manning formulate an empirical equation in 1889 that remains the supreme global standard for river and canal design today?

sessions.title: Most Economical (Hydraulically Efficient) Sections
sessions.subtitle: Optimization of rectangular, trapezoidal (half-hexagon), triangular (90°), and circular cross sections.
sessions.hook: For a fixed volume of excavation and lining material, what exact mathematical geometry delivers the highest possible discharge?

sessions.title: Computation of Normal Depth & Uniform Flow
sessions.subtitle: Section factor AR^(2/3), analytical solutions, Newton-Raphson iterative solvers, and non-erodible canal design.
sessions.hook: How do engineers quickly solve the non-linear implicit Manning equation for water depth without manual trial and error?

sessions.title: Specific Energy Concept & Critical Flow
sessions.subtitle: Bakhmeteff specific energy curve (E-y), alternate depths, critical depth (yc), critical velocity, discharge diagram.
sessions.hook: Why does a channel with a given specific energy have two physically possible depths, and why is critical flow the most unstable state?

sessions.title: Channel Transitions: Width Contractions & Humps
sessions.subtitle: Bed steps (Δz), subcritical vs supercritical behavior, choking phenomenon, critical width (b_min), upstream afflux.
sessions.hook: Why does raising the channel floor cause the water level to drop in subcritical flow, while causing it to rise in supercritical flow?

sessions.title: Hydraulic Jump Mechanics & Stilling Basins
sessions.subtitle: Momentum principle, Bélanger conjugate depth equation, energy dissipation (ΔE), jump classifications, USBR basins.
sessions.hook: How does a stationary standing shockwave dissipate over 70% of a dam's catastrophic kinetic energy within just a few meters?

sessions.title: Gradually Varied Flow (GVF) & Surface Profiles
sessions.subtitle: Dynamic equation of GVF, 12 surface profiles (M, S, C, H, A), control sections, Direct Step Method integration.
sessions.hook: How do river engineers accurately predict how many kilometers upstream a newly constructed reservoir will submerge farm lands?

sessions.title: Impulse-Momentum Principle & Jet Hydrodynamics
sessions.subtitle: Newton's second law for control volumes, momentum flux, jet formation, nozzle velocity coefficient, jet reaction.
sessions.hook: How much dynamic force can a 50 mm jet of water exert when blasted at 30 meters per second against a solid barrier?

sessions.title: Force of Jet on Stationary Flat Plates
sessions.subtitle: Normal impingement, inclined stationary plates at angle θ, normal and tangential force components, discharge ratio.
sessions.hook: When a high-speed jet strikes an inclined plate, how is the incoming water stream mathematically divided into forward and backward flows?

sessions.title: Force of Jet on Stationary Curved Vanes
sessions.subtitle: Center impingement, symmetrical hemispherical cup (Fx = 2ρaV²), tangential entry at vane tip, smooth entry condition.
sessions.hook: Why does curving a plate into a 180° hemispherical bucket precisely double the force exerted by an impinging water jet?

sessions.title: Force of Jet on Moving Flat Plates
sessions.subtitle: Single moving plate (relative velocity V-u), series of flat plates on wheel rim (mass rate ρaV), maximum efficiency.
sessions.hook: Why can a series of flat plates on a rotating wheel reach an efficiency of 50%, while a single moving plate can never exceed 29.6%?

sessions.title: Force of Jet on Moving Curved Vanes
sessions.subtitle: Single moving curved vane, relative velocity, series of curved vanes on wheel periphery, maximum efficiency derivation.
sessions.hook: Under what kinematic conditions can a series of curved vanes extract nearly 100% of the kinetic energy from a moving water jet?

sessions.title: Jet Striking a Series of Radial Vanes
sessions.subtitle: Angular momentum theorem, Euler turbine torque equation, tangential speed variation (u1 vs u2), work done per second.
sessions.hook: How does the law of conservation of angular momentum govern the energy transfer between swirling water and a rotating wheel?

sessions.title: Dynamic Velocity Triangles at Inlet and Outlet
sessions.subtitle: Inlet velocity triangle (V1, u1, Vr1, Vw1, Vf1, α, θ), outlet velocity triangle (V2, u2, Vr2, Vw2, Vf2, β, φ), blade friction.
sessions.hook: How do engineers draw and solve velocity vector triangles to visualize the 3D kinematics of water entering and leaving a moving blade?

sessions.title: Work Done, Runner Power & Hydraulic Efficiency
sessions.subtitle: Euler's head (He), hydraulic efficiency derivation, influence of blade outlet angle and blade friction factor (k).
sessions.hook: Why does setting the outlet whirl velocity to zero maximize the energy conversion efficiency in hydraulic runners?

sessions.title: Jet Propulsion & Fluid Dynamic Reaction on Vessels
sessions.subtitle: Ship propulsion by water jets, nozzles facing ahead vs amidships, propulsive efficiency, comprehensive numerical session.
sessions.hook: How do modern high-speed ferries and naval combat vessels use water jet propulsion to achieve 50+ knots without external propellers?

sessions.title: Introduction to Hydraulic Turbines & Classification
sessions.subtitle: Hydroelectric plant layout, gross head, net head, classification (impulse vs reaction, head, discharge), efficiencies.
sessions.hook: What fundamental engineering principles dictate whether a hydroelectric dam installs a Pelton wheel, a Francis turbine, or a Kaplan propeller?

sessions.title: Pelton Wheel Impulse Turbine: Construction & Governing
sessions.subtitle: Nozzle and spear valve, deflector plate, ellipsoidal double-hemispherical buckets, central splitter, oil pressure governor.
sessions.hook: Why does a Pelton bucket feature a sharp central splitter ridge dividing the incoming water jet into two equal symmetrical sheets?

sessions.title: Pelton Wheel Design & Kinematics
sessions.subtitle: Velocity triangles, speed ratio (φ ≈ 0.46), jet ratio (m = D/d), Tygun's bucket formula, multi-jet configurations.
sessions.hook: Why does the peak hydraulic efficiency of a Pelton turbine occur at a speed ratio of 0.46 rather than the theoretical 0.50?

sessions.title: Francis Inward Radial Flow Reaction Turbine
sessions.subtitle: Spiral casing, stay ring, adjustable wicket gates, runner kinematics, degree of reaction, radial discharge condition.
sessions.hook: Why is the spiral casing of a Francis turbine tapered along its circumference, and why does pressure drop progressively through the runner?

sessions.title: Kaplan & Propeller Turbines & Draft Tube Theory
sessions.subtitle: Axial flow runner, adjustable blades, draft tube pressure recovery, draft tube efficiency, tailrace setting.
sessions.hook: How can a simple diverging pipe below a turbine runner transform wasted discharge kinetic energy back into useful suction pressure head?

sessions.title: Specific Speed, Unit Quantities & Model Laws
sessions.subtitle: Specific speed (Ns), unit speed (Nu), unit discharge (Qu), unit power (Pu), Froude/Reynolds similitude, Moody's scale formula.
sessions.hook: How can a model turbine only 30 cm in diameter precisely predict the power, efficiency, and flow rate of a massive 8-meter hydroelectric turbine?

sessions.title: Turbine Characteristic Curves & Cavitation
sessions.subtitle: Main and operating characteristics, Muschel curves, Thoma's cavitation factor (σ), critical cavitation, prevention.
sessions.hook: What is cavitation, why does it sound like gravel pumping through turbine runners, and how do engineers prevent pitting erosion?

sessions.title: Centrifugal Pumps: Working Principle & Impeller Kinematics
sessions.subtitle: Components, backward curved vanes, volute vs diffuser casing, manometric head (Hm), Euler head, efficiencies.
sessions.hook: Why do virtually all commercial centrifugal pumps use backward-curved impeller blades rather than radial or forward-curved blades?

sessions.title: Pump Characteristics, Series/Parallel & NPSH
sessions.subtitle: Head-discharge curve, system curve, duty point, pumps in series vs parallel, NPSH available vs required, priming.
sessions.hook: What determines the exact point where a pump operates on a pipeline system, and why will a pump fail catastrophically if NPSHA drops below NPSHR?

sessions.title: Introduction to CFD in Hydraulic Engineering
sessions.subtitle: Philosophy of CFD, synergy with flume experiments and 1D theory, modern simulation workflow (pre, solver, post).
sessions.hook: Why has computational fluid dynamics transformed civil engineering from costly physical flume trials into high-fidelity digital prototyping?

sessions.title: Governing Equations of Fluid Dynamics in Conservation Form
sessions.subtitle: Mass conservation, incompressible Navier-Stokes equations, Reynolds decomposition, RANS formulation.
sessions.hook: How do three partial differential equations formulated over 175 years ago govern the intricate 3D motion of every drop of flowing water?

sessions.title: Mathematical Classification of PDEs & Shallow Water Equations
sessions.subtitle: Elliptic, parabolic, and hyperbolic equations; 2D Shallow Water Equations (SWE) / Saint-Venant system.
sessions.hook: Why are shallow water flood waves mathematically hyperbolic, behaving like supersonic shockwaves across river floodplains?

sessions.title: Spatial & Temporal Discretization Techniques
sessions.subtitle: Finite Difference (FDM) vs Finite Volume Method (FVM), cell face flux evaluation, Courant stability (CFL condition).
sessions.hook: What is the Courant-Friedrichs-Lewy (CFL) limit, and why does violating it cause a hydrodynamic simulation to blow up into infinite numbers?

sessions.title: Grid Generation, Mesh Quality & Subgrid Bathymetry
sessions.subtitle: Structured vs unstructured polygonal grids, aspect ratio, skewness, orthogonality, HEC-RAS subgrid bathymetry tables.
sessions.hook: How does subgrid bathymetry enable a coarse 2D computational cell to capture microscopic terrain contours from 1-meter LiDAR data?

sessions.title: Initial & Boundary Conditions in Hydraulic CFD
sessions.subtitle: Inflow hydrographs, stage rating curves, free weir outfalls, solid wall no-slip vs wall functions, Manning's n mapping.
sessions.hook: Why is an ill-posed downstream boundary condition the number one cause of numerical reflection and artificial flooding in river models?

sessions.title: Turbulence Modeling in Hydraulic Systems
sessions.subtitle: Eddy viscosity hypothesis, k-ε model, k-ω SST model, dimensionless wall distance y+, near-wall treatment.
sessions.hook: Why does solving for turbulent kinetic energy (k) and its dissipation rate (ε) allow engineers to predict scour around bridge piers?

sessions.title: HEC-RAS 2D Hydrodynamic Modeling Practice
sessions.subtitle: RAS Mapper, 2D flow areas, breaklines along banks, Diffusive Wave vs Full Momentum, spillway & jump simulation.
sessions.hook: How does HEC-RAS 2D model the turbulent rolling and air-entraining front of a dam-break flood wave across complex topography?

sessions.title: Multiphase VOF Modeling in OpenFOAM & Model Validation
sessions.subtitle: Volume-of-Fluid (VOF) free surface tracking, SimFlow/interFoam, comparing 1D theory, 2D HEC-RAS, 3D CFD, and flume data.
sessions.hook: How do the three pillars of modern hydraulics—analytical theory, physical flume measurement, and CFD simulation—validate each other?
